channel.title: Quote of the day - A-Z Quotes

item.title: Stephenie Meyer
item.description: "I like the night. Without the dark, we'd never see the stars."

item.title: Melanie Clark Pullen
item.description: "You can't put a price tag on love, but you can on all its accessories."

item.title: Jennifer Lopez
item.description: "Doubt is a killer. You just have to know who you are and what you stand for."

item.title: Henry Ward Beecher
item.description: "Young love is a flame; very pretty, often very hot and fierce, but still only light and flickering. The love of the older and disciplined heart is as coals, deep-burning, unquenchable."
